entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petit
 Through: Mr. S.K. Tandon, Advocate.
 versus

.....  Resp  Through: Mr. Rahul Tyagi, ASC for the   with Mr. Jatin, Ms. Preeti an  Mr. Aashish, Advs.
 SI Ravi Kumar from PS Kalkaji  Mr. Atul Kant Chaturvedi  Authorized Signatory of R-2  CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.02.2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.426/2017 PS Kalkaji under sections 406/420/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes in terms of settlement deed dated 16th November, 2017, which is on record of this Court.
2. Petitioner nos. 1 and 2 and Mr. Atul Kant Chaturvedi, Authorized Signatory of respondent no.2 Company is present in the Court and have been duly identified by the IO and the counsel.
3. As per the settlement, an amount of Rs.1 crore has been paid by the petitioners to the respondent no.2 Company.

Mr. Atul Kant Chaturvedi has acknowledged the receipt of the settlement amount and states on behalf of the respondent no.2 Company that the respondent no.2 company has no objection to quashing of the FIR.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Consequently, the FIR No.426/2017 PS Kalkaji under sections 406/420/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
5. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
6. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
7. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
